papers.headline: Low-mass and High-sSFR Hα Emitters at z ∼ 2 in the ZFOURGE-COSMOS Field
papers.summary: We present a near-infrared spectroscopic follow-up study of seven Hα emitter candidates at z∼2 in the ZFOURGE-COSMOS field, selected via the K_s-band flux excess method.
papers.title: Low-mass and High-sSFR Hα Emitters at z ∼ 2 in the ZFOURGE-COSMOS Field

papers.title: X-ray Comptonization in an Accreting Kerr Black Hole System with a Tilted Disc and Thermal Corona; A General-Relativistic Monte Carlo Simulation: I. Model, Radiative Transfer and Spectral-Timing Properties

papers.headline: Cosmological implications of two mock TianQin standard siren catalogs generated under different background cosmological models
papers.summary: Space-borne gravitational wave (GW) detectors such as TianQin are expected to detect GW standard sirens for cosmological parameter estimation. All previous studies of TianQin adopted the ΛCDM model to generate mock standard siren data.
papers.title: Cosmological implications of two mock TianQin standard siren catalogs generated under different background cosmological models
papers.authors: J. Li, S. Wang, L. Zhu
